formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Sets the spender's allowance over the owner's prestoUSDCv vault shares to exactly `value`, replacing any earlier allowance (ERC20PermitUpgradeable.permit -> _approve(owner, spender, value)).
Uses up the owner's current permit nonce.
The signature can only be submitted up to `deadline` (block.timestamp > deadline reverts). After that, the allowance itself has no expiry.

With this allowance the spender can transferFrom the owner's shares, or redeem/withdraw them into USDC sent to any receiver (ERC4626 redeem/withdraw with owner != caller spend the allowance). A max-uint256 value is never reduced when spent.
formats.shown: "Approve <amount> prestoUSDCv for <spender> until <deadline>", with fields for owner, spender, allowance amount ("Unlimited" at max uint), signature deadline and the raw nonce.

findings.title: Permit: the 'until {deadline}' wording suggests the allowance expires, but only the signature does.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json interpolatedIntent "Approve {value} for {spender} until {deadline}"; ERC20PermitUpgradeable.permit only checks `if (block.timestamp > deadline) revert ERC2612ExpiredSignature(deadline);` and then `_approve(owner, spender, value)`, which sets an allowance with no expiry. Case 3 screen: "Approve Unlimited prestoUSDCv for 0x5344… until 2030-01-01".
findings.fix: Change the wording to "Approve {value} for {spender} (signature valid until {deadline})" or drop "until {deadline}" from the intent. The field label 'Signature deadline' is already correct.

findings.title: Permit: the raw nonce is always visible and adds noise the signer can't use.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json field `#.nonce` 'Nonce' format raw, visible always
findings.fix: Set the nonce field to visible "never", or leave it out of the fields.
